free.note: row for qwen/qwen3.8-27b on the rate-limits page (30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD); the page does not label the plan, so it is used as the conservative free-tier configuration

developer.note: 'RATE LIMITS (DEVELOPER PLAN)' column: 250K TPM, 1K RPM; RPD and TPD are not listed (null = no local limit)

headers.x-ratelimit-reset-requests: requests per DAY (RPD), duration such as 2m59.56s
headers.x-ratelimit-reset-tokens: tokens per MINUTE (TPM), duration such as 7.66s

header_policy: header limits are the account's actual limits and replace the configured RPD / TPM once seen; RPM and TPD are not reported in headers and stay as configured
